D1_price_not_expenditure: LOW — a genuine change in WHO PAYS for children
D2_exogeneity: MODERATE — kibbutzim chose whether and when to privatise; the authors address member exit, which is itself selective on income and fertility
D3_channel_separation: LOW — no schooling or mortality channel is in play; cost-sharing IS the treatment
D5_outcome_measurement: LOW — lifetime fertility from universal microdata on members

D1_price_not_expenditure: MODERATE — insurance coverage PROXIES the cost of bearing and rearing a child
D2_exogeneity: SERIOUS — national coverage expansion is not exogenous to the same forces driving the fertility decline
D3_channel_separation: MODERATE — the mortality/replacement channel is modelled explicitly and runs the other way, which is a strength, but the two are separated by functional form rather than by design
D6_transport_to_registered_phenomenon: LOW for FDT (1875-1913, five countries); SERIOUS for SDT

study: Ito & Tanaka (South Africa MCH user fees)
D2_exogeneity: MODERATE — rests on health-facility availability being exogenous, argued from the apartheid allocation
D3_channel_separation: SERIOUS — the price effect and the return-to-quality effect are not separated, and the AUTHORS' own reading is quantity-quality, not a price effect on quantity
overall_reason: well identified for ITS estimand and poorly identified for C.2.b's: the sign is wrong for a price mechanism and right for C.3.d's

study: Xia (Sierra Leone Free Health Care Initiative)
D2_exogeneity: MODERATE — DiD on birth timing x transport cost to a facility
D3_channel_separation: CRITICAL — the paper's own stated channel is revised INFANT-MORTALITY EXPECTATIONS, which is A.1's replacement mechanism and not a price effect at all
D5_outcome_measurement: SERIOUS — the outcome is DESIRED fertility, a stated quantity that never pools with realized
overall_reason: cannot support a C.2.b conclusion at any weight; retained only as a jointly-claimed boundary record with A.1

D1_price_not_expenditure: MODERATE — a SHADOW price net of the child's marginal product, not an out-of-pocket outlay
D2_exogeneity: MODERATE — slave births to mothers owned by the household as shocks to the own-child price
D3_channel_separation: MODERATE — the price and the child's productive VALUE are inseparable by construction, which is why the record is jointly claimed with C.3.a
D6_transport_to_registered_phenomenon: LOW for PM/FDT; SERIOUS for SDT
overall_reason: a careful design on a price the chapter only half owns; informative for the FDT arm and unallocated between C.2.b and C.3.a
